rows.reported_evidence: Ten GM12878 PTA cells and ten SCMDA cells; other method data reused from selected BJ1 cells.
rows.transfer_boundary: Cell-level method comparison includes different backgrounds and screening rules; no matched TMD context panel.

rows.reported_evidence: Reported greater than90% recovery of variants called in the corresponding bulk reference at evaluated read depths.
rows.transfer_boundary: A genome/variant benchmark conditional on reference and assayed cells; not probability of observing a new origin.

rows.reported_evidence: Five-day clonal expansion; bulk reference; reported99.9% germline precision and mean2785 false-positive calls.
rows.transfer_boundary: Bulk-discordant calls initially conflate true somatic variants and artifacts; rare somatic-event truth is a separate problem.

rows.reported_evidence: Live-cell sorting; kindred founder cultures expanded to20–30 cells before reisolation.
rows.transfer_boundary: Dead, nonexpanding and unobserved lineages are outside this sequenced frame; no all-birth denominator.

rows.reported_evidence: Coverage and cross-sample rules; DMEM calls require a private single-cell variant absent from covered bulk reference.
rows.transfer_boundary: These rules are neither R20 any-call inclusion nor a generic two-carrier-plus-reference caller; freeze actual predicate and exclusions.

rows.reported_evidence: ENU/MAN/vehicle example; reported five cells per group except four at highest ENU; cells harvested after exposure and viability sorting.
rows.transfer_boundary: Assayed-cell numbers are not independent founder histories or all exposed-cell retention. No prevention intervention or clinical result.

rows.reported_evidence: RF features include allele balance and sequence context; linked-read/spectrum methods set a sample-specific classification cutoff.
rows.transfer_boundary: Freeze the entire algorithm, including adaptation, and validate on untouched target-state truth; a fitted spectrum is not independent calibration truth.

rows.reported_evidence: Reported74% out-of-bag accuracy; mixtures and modified sequence contexts test existing feature records.
rows.transfer_boundary: Training/out-of-bag, synthetic modified features and new biological observations are distinct evidence types.

rows.reported_evidence: WT/FANCC/MSH2 clonal cultures and elapsed-day extrapolations benchmark observed burdens; exact artifact totals unknown.
rows.transfer_boundary: Repair genotypes differ, histories are nested, and elapsed-day benchmarks are not optically counted new independent mutation births.

rows.reported_evidence: Reported45–69% detection of shared substitutions and31–56% of shared indels;86.8% mean sensitivity for detectable substitutions in callable loci.
rows.transfer_boundary: Conditional classifier performance cannot be substituted for full assay inclusion. Do not multiply percentages with incompatible denominators.

rows.measurement: Estimated truth and reused ENU data
rows.reported_evidence: Signature-refit estimates:89% sensitivity in high-ENU samples and37% in low-burden vehicle; exact artifacts unknown in some assessments.
rows.transfer_boundary: This reuses the PTA study dataset; signature-based estimates are not an independently observed complete truth catalogue.

rows.reported_evidence: Five single cells from a clonal intestinal organoid; signature-refit evaluation. True indels can be removed by exclusion rules.
rows.transfer_boundary: Possible assay feasibility lead, not a prospective origin-control experiment or cancer validation.

rows.reported_evidence: Paired bulk controls and quality rules; truth labels combine shared bulk/PTA calls, linked-read scores and expected low cord-blood burden.
rows.transfer_boundary: Reference absence is not universal proof of de novo birth. Copy/LOH exclusions and unavailable reference states need explicit target-domain limits.

rows.reported_evidence: Indel exclusion uses139 PTA samples from22 individuals and homopolymer rules; burden extrapolated from callable autosomal territory.
rows.transfer_boundary: Individuals, cells and variants are different units; exclusions can remove true events and normalization is not division exposure.

rows.reported_evidence: Six rats dosed per group; first five assayed with sixth reserved. Paired liver/lung and cII/ECS use the same animals/DNA.
rows.transfer_boundary: Animals are the biological units; two assays, two tissues, DNA molecules and loci do not double the independent animal count.

rows.reported_evidence: Twenty2.4kb target regions;500ng DNA input; over500million informative duplex bases per sample.
rows.transfer_boundary: 48kb target territory and duplex bases are molecule/callable denominators, not cells, division counts or distinct origin truth.

rows.measurement: Positive control and two frequency conventions
rows.reported_evidence: ENU positive control; MFmin unique mutations versus MFmax unique plus clonal observations; article reports no difference here.
rows.transfer_boundary: A positive response verifies a stated assay function, not a complete carrier/origin catalogue; deduplication cannot reconstruct every molecular origin.

rows.reported_evidence: Reported same-DNA Pearsonr=.99, dose response and tissue NOGELs; benchmark analysis uses50% critical effect size.
rows.transfer_boundary: Correlated assays are useful corroboration, not independent origin truth, a TMD threshold or a cancer-prevention effect.

rows.reported_evidence: Paragraph34 opens with≥10mg/kg in both tissues, then specifies lung≥1; concluding paragraph56 specifies lung≥1 and liver≥10.
rows.transfer_boundary: Retain this wording distinction; no raw reanalysis, silent correction or clinical safety threshold is inferred.

rows.reported_evidence: Systemic exposure, DNA adducts, repair enzyme activity and metabolic expression not characterized in this study.
rows.transfer_boundary: Tissue-specific repair/metabolism explanations are hypotheses here; one nitrosamine does not establish universal transfer.
